# Copilot CLI Desktop agent instructions

Before you report a substantive fix or a behaviour claim as done, follow the
`principles` skill: give evidence a reviewer can re-run, label the result PASS,
FAIL, SKIP, INCONCLUSIVE or UNVERIFIED, and cite only the principles that
changed a decision. Also follow `bug-fix` for a bug fix. Replies that make no
such claim, such as questions and lookups, need none of this. Build and test
commands live in the [README](../README.md#development); link them rather than
restating them.
